title: Images and Multimedia
description: Using images, audio, and video elements to embed multimedia content in web pages.

flashcards.question: Which tag is used to embed an image in HTML?
What attribute specifies the image source URL?
Why is the alt attribute important for images?
flashcards.answer: It provides alternative text for accessibility and when the image fails to load.

flashcards.question: How do you embed an audio file?
Which attribute adds playback controls to audio and video elements?
How do you embed a video in HTML?
What attribute defines multiple video sources for browser compatibility?
Can you autoplay audio or video in HTML?
flashcards.answer: Yes, by using the autoplay attribute, but some browsers restrict autoplay for usability reasons.

flashcards.question: How do you make a video loop continuously?
What is the purpose of the poster attribute in the <video> tag?
flashcards.answer: It specifies an image to show before the video plays.
